info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Notification Subscriptions Webhook Test Subscriptions-v5-spec
info.description: The Notification Webhook Test Subscriptions API allows users to manage and evaluate test subscriptions for webhooks. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can retrieve information about specific test subscriptions associated with a given webhook ID. This is particularly useful for testing integrations and ensuring that notifications are functioning correctly before deploying to production. Typical consumers include application developers and integration specialists who require reliable hooks for real-time data updates.

get.summary: Retrieve test subscriptions for a specific webhook resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of test subscriptions for the specified webhook identified by resource ID RES-100045. Use this to validate your webhook configuration and monitor test events.
